evidence: GCE has developed a suite of AI tools, including its proprietary Mosaic platform, which provides centralized, secure, and permission-based access for students, faculty, and staff.
These solutions aim to improve operational efficiency, enhance academic support, and include training resources to advance AI literacy.
We have made, and expect to continue making, investments in the integration of AI into our platforms, products, and services.
While we expect our use of AI to help grow our business and benefit our university partners, the use of AI presents various risks, challenges, and potential unintended consequences.
ai_positioning.summary: LOPE développe et intègre des outils IA propriétaires (plateforme Mosaic) dans ses produits et services pour améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle et le support académique, tout en reconnaissant les risques et défis associés à cette intégration.
